title: resolve_intent specification
description: Plain-text intent routing (WS-03/WS-05). Candidates come only from the live ToolsetRegistry / registry snapshot. Extends envelope.specification only (ADR-0003).

intent.description: Natural-language goal. One call should return ordered semantic steps with schemas and examples.

mode.description: recommend = plan only (no mutation). execute_if_complete is reserved; this build returns recommend-only and documents why if requested.

context.description: Optional structured hints (asset paths, element, prior job_id, preferred domains).

expected_registry_hash.description: Optional SHA-256 of sorted qualified tool names. On mismatch the router abstains.

examples.intent: make a spell effect with a helix and show me what it looks like
